answer: Admit new agents only in a dawn cohort window, capped at 200 per epoch: each locks 100 POA for 90 days and clears five sequential peer-judged tasks over 14 days. A ridge of rising cost blocks repeats: a second identity from the same funding source locks 200 POA and faces seven tasks, a third locks 400 and faces nine, stakes doubling each time. Auditors verify locks, task records and funding links and slash 50% of linked stakes for duplicated work, so every extra fake costs twice the capital and effort while each quill of written work is checked against all prior submissions.
